sources.title: QEF project 2020/0355: 「悅」讀‧愈讀
sources.finding: Confirms ATS project. Detail page offers only the proposal link; no final report or plans were linked when checked.

sources.title: QEF revised proposal 2020/0355
sources.inspection: All 13 pages rendered and visually checked; text extracted.
sources.finding: No floor-plan drawing. Pages 10-11 contain procurement and works estimates, including roughly 2,500 sq ft of vinyl flooring, 8 individual reading seats and associated glass doors, two replacement library doors, and low/tall/full-height book cabinets. Borrowing, self-study and lecture areas are mentioned. These are proposal specifications, not verified as-built quantities or placements. No room dimensions, orientation or window/door coordinates.

sources.title: Official 2026/27 school prospectus
sources.inspection: Complete 40,282,231-byte PDF downloaded with verified ranges; 19 PDF pages/spreads rendered and visually checked.
sources.finding: School history, courses, activities, general facilities/photos and street access map. No library floor plan or dimensioned room drawing. Small reading-activity photographs do not register the library into campus coordinates.

sources.title: 2023/24 annual report
sources.inspection: 53-page text reviewed for library/layout terms; relevant page 17 visually checked.
sources.finding: No usable plan found. PDF page 17 (printed 16) contains a close photograph of a Chinese-script exhibition with dark window frames and pale wood low cabinets, probably library but caption alone does not establish room identity. It cannot establish dimensions or orientation.

sources.title: 2024/25 annual report
sources.inspection: 64-page text reviewed for library/layout terms; relevant pages 21 and 23 rendered and visually checked.
sources.finding: No usable plan found. PDF page 23 (printed 22) has two low-resolution cultural-reading activity photographs: shelves, a wood-framed door, exit sign, and television on wood panel are visible. Shared with visual-research agent for comparison with HKLA photographs. They provide local appearance only.

sources.title: 2025/26 annual report
sources.inspection: 73-page text reviewed for library/layout terms; page 22 rendered and visually checked.
sources.finding: No usable plan found. Reading activity photograph on page 22 is a classroom, not the renovated library; excluded as a library modeling reference.
